data.cultural_impact: The name 'Tuhfah' holds a significant cultural meaning in Islamic tradition. It is believed that the giving and receiving of gifts is a sign of love, respect, and appreciation, showcasing the strong bond between individuals or communities. This is exemplified through various practices such as giving Quranic verses as gifts to mark special occasions or milestones and the sharing of food during festivities. The name 'Tuhfah' serves as a reminder of the importance of expressing love and gratitude towards others and the numerous blessings that come through such interactions.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Tuhfah' represents Allah's boundless kindness and mercy towards His creation. As mentioned in the Quran, "Verily, Allah (Al-Muntaqqim) does not neglect (recompense) the smallest reward, and they shall have none to degrade [them]; honored shall be the dwelling of those who resist [evil], and surely, will be the reward of the Hereafter is better and abiding" (32:17,18). Allah is the ultimate giver, bestowing His countless blessings upon us in various forms, whether it be through the natural world or in the form of the Prophets, Rasulullahs and Awliyas who have guided us to the righteous path. The name 'Tuhfah' serves as a source of inspiration to constantly strive for the pleasure of Allah and His Rasul, and to seek His blessings through good deeds and righteous intentions.
